_doc: Discovered free-inference provider candidates. Verified 2026-05-11 by checking each provider's docs + pricing + live API probes where keys available. status field: 'verified-free' = permanent free tier confirmed; 'trial-only' = one-time credit then pays; 'not-free' = drop, requires CC/paid; 'wired-deadkey' = registered but our key invalid/empty/$0. Each entry: provider, signup URL, free_tier_truth, RPD/RPM/TPM if known, recommendation.

candidates.free_tier_truth: $5 trial credit (30 days, no CC) + 200k TPD permanent free tier after trial. Per-model rate-limited.
candidates.recommendation: STRONG — permanent 200k TPD across all models, fast inference. SAMBANOVA_API_KEY in .env is empty, needs sign-up + key.

candidates.free_tier_truth: Permanent free w/ GitHub account. Free tier: 10 RPM, 50 RPD per model / 2000 RPD total, 8k input + 4k output tokens, 2 concurrent.
candidates.recommendation: STRONG — permanent free, accessible to anyone w/ GitHub. GITHUB_MODELS_TOKEN in .env is empty; create PAT w/ models:read scope.

candidates.free_tier_truth: Singapore intl endpoint: 1M input + 1M output tokens free trial, 90 days. After trial: pay-per-token. US endpoint has NO free quota.
candidates.recommendation: MEDIUM — top IQ in free space, but Qwen XML tool-call issue (already excluded for cerebras/openrouter qwen). Worth it only for non-tool-calling pools (compress, mid). Trial-only.

candidates.free_tier_truth: $0.10/month free credit (Free tier) or $2/month (PRO subscriber). Routes to 19+ underlying providers (Cerebras, Groq, SambaNova, Together, Replicate, etc). Pay-as-you-go after credit.
candidates.recommendation: WEAK — $0.10/mo is tiny (~few dozen calls). Useful as proxy router only if subscribed PRO ($9/mo for $2 credit).

candidates.free_tier_truth: $1 one-time signup credit. ~2 months small usage. Then pay-as-you-go. 600 RPM standard, 6000 RPM account-wide cap.
candidates.recommendation: WEAK — only $1 burst credit. Not worth integrating for ongoing use.

candidates.free_tier_truth: $5/month free credit w/ any Vercel team account (incl. free hobby). Pay-as-you-go after credit at provider list prices, no markup. Spans all available models.
candidates.recommendation: MEDIUM — $5/mo recurring is decent. Useful as failover gateway. Worth a low-priority pool entry if Vercel account active.

candidates.free_tier_truth: 5M tokens (~$8.40 value, 30-day expiry) on signup, no CC needed. Then pay-per-token: V4 Flash $0.14/M input, $0.28/M output. 60 RPM default.
candidates.recommendation: PROVIDER REGISTERED but DEEPSEEK_API_KEY has $0 balance — 'Insufficient Balance' on every call. Sign up new account or fund existing to revive.

candidates.free_tier_truth: NO API free tier. Must add CC to get API key. Pro subscribers ($20/mo) get $5/mo Sonar credit. Chat-app free queries do NOT extend to API.
candidates.recommendation: DROP — not actually free at API level. Was misclassified by scout.

verification_notes: Each entry verified via vendor pricing pages, /v1/models endpoint probes where reachable, and live chat-completion calls where API keys present. SambaNova + GitHub-Models = strongest new additions (permanent free tiers). Perplexity dropped (paywall). Alibaba/Qwen = trial-only and has tool-call format issue. DeepSeek needs key revival.
